info.title: Coderax WorkflowEngine API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP surface for Coderax Native intelligence, agent orchestration and durable Work execution. Every operation is generated from the versioned route catalogue.

get.summary: Liveness and dependency health for the engine.
Whether the engine finished startup validation.
Discover the three agent identities and their truthful availability.
Discover models, cost class and the zero-cost route.

post.summary: One Chat turn. Streams SSE frames when the client accepts them.
Submit a durable Work task; returns before execution finishes.

get.summary: Authoritative task status, including terminal state and failure.

post.summary: Request cancellation. Safe from any replica and after disconnect.
Resume a suspended or interrupted task from its last checkpoint.
Retry a failed task on the same engine with a new generation.

get.summary: Replay and tail execution events from a sequence cursor.
Conversation history shared by web and CLI clients.
One conversation with its persisted messages.
Owner-scoped memory for the requested data mode.
Pending and decided permission requests for a task.

post.summary: Approve or deny one scoped permission request.

get.summary: Owner-scoped durable artifacts in one data-mode partition.

post.summary: Store a new artifact version from base64-encoded bytes.

get.summary: Version-pinned manifest for one project, with a digest of the entry list.

post.summary: Delete this owner’s artifacts whose retention has expired.

get.summary: Authoritative metadata for one artifact in the requested mode.

post.summary: Append a new immutable version to an existing artifact.

get.summary: Retained version history for one artifact, newest last.

post.summary: Point an artifact at an existing immutable version without deleting newer ones.

get.summary: Exact bytes of one artifact version, integrity-verified on read.
Portable export: descriptor, version manifest and exact bytes.

post.summary: Delete an artifact and every retained version it owns.
Generate, verify and durably persist a document, workbook, deck, analysis or software project.

get.summary: Durable completion notifications, including unread count.
